title: launch-observatory
universal_lens: The Launch Observatory formalizes a strict bipartite partition between internal operator state and public customer observables. Deterministic synthesis operators map high-dimensional telemetry into bounded health vectors, enforcing epistemic boundaries where missing inputs yield strictly undefined states rather than hallucinated metrics.
gsi_mapping: Jarvis acts as a conformal synthesizer over live ingestion streams. Sectional health indicators represent posterior confidence intervals; bootstrap picks are explicitly masked from the learning loop to prevent prior contamination, ensuring only canonical history updates the Bayesian performance priors.
gse_mapping: The system enforces a discrete phase-transition automaton (Phases 1-9). The cockpit serves as the global state monitor, applying hard safety gates that veto public exposure until all environmental dependencies and settlement constraints reach a stable, validated equilibrium.

primitives.name: Operator-Customer Epistemic Split
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Launch Observatory The Sports Intelligence OS is built around a hard split between what a customer can see and what an operator can see.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: O: Operator state space (dimensionless), C: Customer observable space (dimensionless). O \cap C = \emptyset.
primitives.assumptions: Information leakage across the boundary is strictly prohibited without deterministic transformation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if internal validation fails but public surfaces remain active, causing reality distortion.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSE's secure enclave architecture, isolating raw model weights from public API endpoints.
layer2.telemetry: Zero cross-boundary data leaks during audit.

primitives.name: Bootstrap vs Canonical Ledger

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P_b: Bootstrap picks (excluded from learning), P_c: Canonical picks (included). W: Win/Loss metric.
primitives.assumptions: Bootstrap picks are necessary for end-to-end system stress testing but carry zero epistemic weight for model training.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If P_b is accidentally included in W calculations, public performance metrics suffer severe inflation bias.

layer2.telemetry: Exact match of canonical counts against public API aggregations.

The Launch Observatory establishes a rigorous mathematical framework for managing the lifecycle of sports intelligence products. At its core is the epistemic partition, a hard boundary separating the high-dimensional operator state space from the constrained customer observable space. This prevents premature exposure of unvalidated model outputs. The Jarvis synthesizer operates as a pure function within this space, mapping live database counts and environmental variables into a discrete assessment manifold. Crucially, it adheres to a 'no-fabrication' principle: missing inputs do not trigger interpolation but rather collapse the local state to an explicit UNKNOWN, preserving epistemic integrity. Furthermore, the system introduces a temporal duality through bootstrap versus canonical histories. Bootstrap picks serve as synthetic test vectors, allowing the engine to undergo full end-to-end stress testing without contaminating the Bayesian learning loop. Only when the operator explicitly flips the CANONICAL_HISTORY_ENABLED switch do these events transition into the canonical ledger, becoming eligible for public performance aggregation and model retraining. This creates a robust state-transition automaton governed by a nine-phase matrix, ensuring that every component—from ingestion to settlement—reaches a validated GREEN state before public launch. The forensic ledger provides a retroactive audit trail, guaranteeing that every exclusion or inclusion in the performance metrics is mathematically traceable.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models two primary agents: the Operator, who requires comprehensive, unfiltered telemetry to manage risk and validate infrastructure, and the Customer, who demands a curated, statistically sound representation of predictive power. The Observatory anticipates the Operator's need for immediate failure detection via sectional health warnings, while simultaneously shielding the Customer from the chaotic, unresolved states inherent in live data ingestion.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical anti-collinearity condition exists between the bootstrap ledger and the public performance API. If bootstrap picks leak into the canonical aggregation, the win-rate metric becomes collinear with synthetic noise, destroying trust. The system enforces a hard veto: `isBootstrap=true` strictly implies exclusion from `snapshot.eligibleForLearning`. Additionally, environmental missingness triggers a top-level launch veto, preventing any public surface from rendering until all external configuration dependencies are resolved.
